records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have North Studio here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, reached first project on day 2 ([calendar:ff2f6fa3] welcome call held, [email:e300e7f1] onboarding), showing real early engagement. But no invites sent, no key milestone, no inbound contact since, and only 8 days left. Solo Starter accounts that go quiet after project creation often stall.

draft.subject: Nice start on your first North Studio project
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for making time for the welcome call last week -- good to see your first project up in Wrenfield already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right foundation.

A common next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for your team.

Best,
Priya
